name: Goodman Hayward
text: After you play a Larder item: your Hedgerow folk have +1/+1 per gold this game.
golden_text: After you play a Larder item: your Hedgerow folk have +2/+2 per gold this game.

source.note: Pass 3; amended tribe gates and provisional paper B/C rates in content/pass3/rates.json.

details: Cashing or feeding a Larder item both count. Uncapped standing tribe bonus applies to Hedgerow folk now and later, including shop units. Units summoned in fights do not get it.
golden_details: Cashing or feeding a Larder item both count. Uncapped standing tribe bonus applies to Hedgerow folk now and later, including shop units. Units summoned in fights do not get it.
